scientific_claim: Completed-hour normalized signed aggressive taker quote imbalance contains incremental information about the next completed-hour return beyond recent return and realized-volatility controls.
claim_boundary: Predictive association / incremental forecast information only. No causal order-flow claim, strategy edge, Router, Qnty, trading, capital, signing, or promotion authority.
mechanism: Aggressive buyers and sellers reveal short-lived demand pressure that may persist into the immediately following hour after controlling for recent price movement and volatility state.

source_contract.bar_identity: Provider kline open time identifies the one-hour candle. Scientific logical close boundary C maps to provider open_time = C - 1h and provider close_time = C - 1ms. Logical origin timestamps are derived from open_time + 1h, not copied from provider close_time.
source_contract.logical_close_to_provider_query: For an inclusive logical close range [A,B], request provider kline open times from A-1h through B-1h inclusive.
source_contract.completed_bar_gate: A bar is admissible only after its provider close_time has elapsed and the response open_time exactly matches the expected logical-close-minus-1h identity.

warmup_contract.purpose: Prospective source/control warmup only; not candidate origins and not scientific outcomes.
warmup_contract.missing_warmup_rule: Do not shift or replace scheduled origins. Any origin lacking the exact 24 completed control returns is invalid until sufficient prospectively collected contiguous history exists.

prospective_window.origin_definition: Each origin C is the logical close boundary of one completed 1h source candle whose provider open_time is C-1h. Features use information available no later than that completed candle; the outcome is the immediately following completed-hour return.

terminal_outcome_tail.purpose: Collect the one and only outcome candle owned by the final scheduled origin; this is not an additional origin or schedule extension.

feature_contract.name: signed_taker_quote_imbalance
feature_contract.domain: [-1,1] when provider fields are internally consistent

control_contract.r1_t: log(close_t / open_t) on the completed source candle ending at logical origin C
control_contract.r24_t: log(close_t / close_{t-24}) using the close at C and the close exactly 24 completed hourly bars earlier
control_contract.rv24_t: sqrt(sum of squared hourly log close-to-close returns over the 24 completed returns ending at logical origin C))
control_contract.first_origin_history_requirement: The first origin at 2026-09-16T00:00:00Z requires close observations at hourly logical boundaries from 2026-09-15T00:00:00Z through 2026-09-16T00:00:00Z inclusive: 24 prospectively collected warmup boundary closes plus the first evaluated source-candle close, yielding 25 close points and exactly 24 completed close-to-close returns.

outcome_contract.name: next_hour_return
outcome_contract.outcome_candle_identity: For logical origin C, outcome candle provider open_time = C and logical close boundary = C+1h.
outcome_contract.outcome_available_only_after: provider close_time for the C..C+1h candle has elapsed
outcome_contract.overlap_policy: Hourly outcomes may be adjacent but each origin owns exactly one next-hour candle once.

primary_model.formula: next_hour_return ~ signed_taker_quote_imbalance + r1_t + r24_t + rv24_t + symbol_fixed_effects
primary_model.symbol_fixed_effects: Include intercept plus ETHUSDT, SOLUSDT, BNBUSDT and XRPUSDT indicators; BTCUSDT is the frozen reference category.

covariance.score_definition: After pooled OLS, for each hourly logical origin C sum x_iC * residual_iC across all valid symbols i to form one coefficient-score vector g_C.
covariance.long_run_meat: S = sum_C g_C g_C' + sum_{l=1..24} (1-l/25) * sum_C [g_C g_{C-l}' + g_{C-l} g_C']
covariance.reason: The lag is 24 clock-hours, not 24 stacked panel rows; summing scores within each origin admits arbitrary contemporaneous dependence across the five symbols.

primary_model.primary_p_value: two-sided normal-reference p-value from the frozen time-clustered HAC standard error

diagnostic_contract.symbol_specific_slopes: For each symbol separately, fit next_hour_return ~ signed_taker_quote_imbalance + r1_t + r24_t + rv24_t with intercept using OLS. Only the sign of the imbalance coefficient enters the support gate; no per-symbol p-value threshold is used.

concentration.nuisance_matrix: intercept + frozen symbol fixed effects + r1_t + r24_t + rv24_t
concentration.residualization: Use Frisch-Waugh-Lovell residuals x_tilde and y_tilde after separately projecting signed_taker_quote_imbalance and next_hour_return on the same nuisance matrix over all valid pooled rows.
concentration.symbol_contribution: c_i = abs(sum over valid origins C of x_tilde_iC * y_tilde_iC)

conditions: at least 4 of 5 frozen symbol-specific diagnostic imbalance slopes are > 0
each symbol has at least 2592 valid origins (90% of 2880 scheduled origins)
maximum frozen residualized concentration share across symbols <= 0.35

next_action: Independent hostile review of this outcome-blind preregistration. If canonicalized cleanly, create a separate implementation/recorder qualification phase early enough to begin the exact prospective control warmup at 2026-09-15T00:00:00Z. Do not access real prospective observations in this preregistration phase.
